title: Account Management Bulletin — Lifecycle of a Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
## Implementation and go-live

Implementation of a Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement starts when the employer's payroll contact and first test file arrive, and the program goes live when the first payroll file validates. An agreement is cancelled before implementation only while its status is contracted.

## Suspension and reinstatement

The desk suspends only an agreement whose status is live. The desk suspends a live program when any deduction schedule or employer-liable shortfall has been past due for the tier's suspension period, in calendar days, or more, the days past due being the calendar days from the item's due date to today, zero when today is on or before the due date. While suspended, the employer's workers cannot take new transfers but recoveries continue. A suspended program is reinstated once every past-due remittance and late charge is paid, the tier requiring full cure.

## Termination

Termination is the employer's own decision, given in writing by an authorized requester. A termination notice is accepted only while the agreement status is live. A termination takes effect no earlier than the tier's notice period, in calendar days, after the termination notice date. Calendar days are counted from the day after the termination notice date, so the earliest termination date is that date plus the notice days. The program terminates on the later of that date and the date the employer named, once the final deduction schedule is settled within the tier's final settlement period in business days; a termination effective before the end of the current term bills the early termination fee on the program invoice, and one effective on or after the renewal date bills none.

The notice date is the termination notice date recorded on the agreement.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Facts | Result |
|---|---|
| 20-day suspension period; a schedule past due 19 calendar days | not yet suspended |
| the same schedule past due 20 calendar days on a live program | suspended |
| 60-day notice given on a day N; employer names N plus 45 days | terminates on N plus 60 days, the later date |
| 60-day notice given on day N; employer names N plus 75 days | terminates on N plus 75 days |
| notice requested while the agreement is suspended | not accepted |
